spans.s: दैव (I) a. (f. वी) Relating to gods, divine, celestial, R.i.60, Bg.iv.25, ix.13, Yaj.ii.235.
दैव (II) m. One of the eight forms of marriage. In it, the daughter is made over at a sacrifice to the officiating priest. See Yaj.i.59. (For the eight forms, See M.iii.21).
दैव (III) n. 1. Destiny, fortune, fate, chance, दैवे पराग्वदनशालिनि हंत जाते Bh.V.iii.1, दैवं निहत्य कुरु पौरुषमात्मशक्त्या Hit.i., Sr.
; 2. a deity; 3. a religious offering, an oblation.
दैव (I) a. (f. वी) Relating to gods, divine, celestial, R.i.60, Bg.iv.25, ix.13, Yaj.ii.235.
दैव-अत्यय m. Evil resulting from unusual natural phenomena.
दैव-अहोरात्र m. a day of the gods, i.e. a human year.
दैव-आयत्त a. dependant on destiny, दैवायत्तं कुले जन्म मदधीनं तु पौरुषम् Ve.iii.
दैव-उपहत a. ill-fated, unfortunate.
दैव-कर्मन् n. offering oblations to gods.
दैव-कोविद, -चिंतक, -ज्ञ m. an astrologer, a fortuneteller, Yaj.i.313.
दैव-कोविद, -चिंतक, -ज्ञ m. an astrologer, a fortuneteller, Yaj.i.313.
दैव-कोविद, -चिंतक, -ज्ञ m. an astrologer, a fortuneteller, Yaj.i.313.
दैव-गति f. the course of fate, मुक्ताजालं चिरपरिचितं त्याजितो देवगत्या Megh.ii.33.
दैव-तंत्र a. dependant on fate.
दैव-तस् ind. perchance, through fortune.
दैव-दीप m. the eye.
दैव-दुर्विपाक m. hardness of fortune, un-propitiousness of fate.
दैव-पर a. 1. trusting to fate; 2. fated, predestined.
दैव-प्रश्न m. fortune-telling, astrology.
दैव-युग n. a Yuga of the gods, consisting of 12,000 divine years.
दैव-योग m. fortuitous combination, fortune, chance.(दैवयोगेन, दैवयोगात् ‘fortunately,’ ‘accidentally.’)
दैव-लेखक m. a fortuneteller, an astrologer.
दैव-वश n. the power of destiny.
दैव-वाणी f. 1. voice from heaven; 2. the Sanskrit language. Cf., संस्कृतं नाम दैवां वागन्वाख्याता महर्षिभिः K.D.i.33.
दैव-हीन a. unfortunate, unlucky.
दैवक m. A god, a deity.
दैवत (I) a. (f. ती) Divine.
दैवत (II) n. 1. A god, a deity, e.g. किं हरिहरब्रह्मादिभिर्दैवतैः Am.

; 2. the whole class of deities; 3. an idol. (This word is also masculine, but not in use in that gender. Mammata finds fault with its use in that gender in the following verse, तथा मन्ये दैवतोऽस्य पिशाचो राक्षसोऽथ वा K.Pr.vii.)
दैवत (I) a. (f. ती) Divine.
दैवत्य a. (f. त्या) Addressed to a deity, sacred to a deity, Yaj.i.99.
दैवत्य a. (f. त्या) Addressed to a deity, sacred to a deity, Yaj.i.99.
दैवल m. The servant of an evil spirit.
दैवारिप m. A conch shell.
दैवासुर m. The natural enmity subsisting between the gods and demons.
दैविक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to the gods, divine, M.i.65.
दैविक (II) n. An inevitable accident.
दैविक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to the gods, divine, M.i.65.
दैविन् m. An astrologer.
दैव्य (I) a. (f. व्या or व्यी) Divine.
दैव्य (II) m. Fortune, fate.
दैव्य (I) a. (f. व्या or व्यी) Divine.
दैव्य (I) a. (f. व्या or व्यी) Divine.
